title: Staircases and lengths
notes: First routes in all bands: P1-2 for different staircases and their lengths, then P3 if children want a closer route. On return, K-1 can explore fewest turns (P4) or add leftward travel (P5-6). Grades 2-3 can justify the turn minimum (P4) or construct fixed longer paths (P5). Grades 4-5 can separate the minimum-turn proof (P4), narrower strips (P5), and leftward travel/finite approximation questions (P6-7). Save actual-size route records and keep location closeness distinct from traveled length.
